en: Colorized panoramic view over a historic European city with many red-tiled roofs, tree‑lined streets and a few larger light‑colored buildings in the foreground. In the distance are green hills with scattered structures on the ridgelines. The caption in the upper left reads in German "Graz von der Roseggerwarte." The overall style resembles an early 20th‑century printed postcard.
